ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Required. Add a short heading that clearly explains the next step. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionTitle.placeholder: Make the next step feel simple.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Briefly explain the value or next step. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Help visitors understand the value and take action with confidence.

SectionImage.helper: Required. Uploads go to Content/. Use a square image at least 800 by 800 pixels, with important details near the center.

SectionImageAltText.helper: Optional but important for accessibility. Describe the image for visitors using screen readers. Leave this blank only when the image is purely decorative.
SectionImageAltText.placeholder: A person confidently taking the next step

PrimaryCTAText.helper: Optional. Add button text to display the primary action. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

PrimaryCTAURL.helper: Required. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. The image links here, and the primary button appears when text is also provided.

PrimaryCTAIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

SecondaryCTAText.helper: Optional. Add this together with a Secondary CTA URL to display a visually secondary action. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SecondaryCTAURL.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. The secondary action appears only when both text and a valid URL are provided.

SecondaryCTAIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building
